name: Athena Global Technologies Limited
about: Athena Global Technologies Limited provides software application development, quality assurance (QA) and testing, and digital transformation solutions and services to enterprises in India and internationally. It operates through Software Services; Real Estate; Online Pharmacy Platform services; Online Trade of Pharmaceuticals Products; Online Education Services; and Leasing Activity segments. The company offers process automation; ai-driven analytics; Conversational AI and chatbots; computer vision solutions; intelligent testing and QA; and AI model development services. It also offers enterprise information management, enterprise integration, and data warehousing are reinforced by deep capability across artificial intelligence, blockchain, data science, IoT, RPA, conversational AI, application development, and product engineering services. In addition, it is involved in the software services, real estate, online pharmacy platform services, online trade of pharmaceutical products, and online education services. It serves the financial, healthcare, oil, pharmaceutical, retail, business services, education, IT, and government industries. The company exports its services. The company was formerly known as VJIL Consulting Limited and changed its name to Athena Global Technologies Limited in October 2015. Athena Global Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
